context.feature_name: How do I choose an email format: Basic, Designed or Custom HTML?
context.faq_text: When you write an email in Vome you now choose how it is built. The choice sits under Body, labelled Choose email format. Basic is the editor you already know. Designed builds the email from blocks. Custom HTML lets you paste a complete HTML email. Dynamic variables work in all three formats. See Dynamic variables in Vome emails.

context.faq_text: The kiosk lets volunteers check in and out of their shifts on a shared device at your site. Volunteers search their name or use their PIN. Hours are logged automatically when they check out.
